article_notes: Prospective study, 97 B. rossi-infected dogs (RLB-PCR confirmed mono-infection) and 15 healthy controls, Onderstepoort academic hospital, Oct 2011-Apr 2013, ethics V055-11. Outcome = short-term survival to discharge vs death/euthanasia for poor prognosis (12 died, 85 survived; median time to death 24 h). Overlapping cohort (CH03): the same hospital, period, ethics number (V055-11) and 15 controls as the first cohort of CB050 (96 infected + 15 controls, Goddard et al. cytokine cohort); the dogs are almost certainly largely the same animals as CB050 cohort 1 (97 vs 96 infected), so CB145 and CB050 are not independent. Statistics: Kruskal-Wallis across controls/survivors/non-survivors, Mann-Whitney U post hoc; Table 1 superscript b marks p < 0.05 non-survivors vs survivors. Exact p values for non-significant survivor vs non-survivor comparisons are not reported (p_value = NS). Per-marker n not reported (missing TEG/assay values not stated); n_total = 97 assumed. Table 1 footnote is duplicated in the Markdown (conversion artefact), table otherwise clean. Post mortem microthrombi in 8/12 non-survivors are descriptive only (no comparison group) and not extracted. Skipped: infected vs healthy control comparisons for all 28 Table 1 variables plus sex.
